answer.rationale: The two declining metrics (onboarding completion -4%, activation -6%) point at the top of the self-serve funnel, and the inherited record most directly on point is memory_86 (shortening onboarding lifted completion and time-to-value) with memory_31 (fewer signup fields lifted first-week activation) as apparent corroboration. That is exactly why I want those two verified rather than the ones I am not acting on: memory_31 and memory_86 are suspiciously similar in claim and could be two consolidations of a single underlying experiment, in which case what looks like independent replication is really one data point and my confidence should drop sharply. Pulling both source records is the cheapest way to learn whether I have one finding or two. I am deliberately not spending budget on memory_73 (promotional pricing) because even if its numbers are understated, the recorded -12pp early retention hit makes it a poor match for a sustainable-long-term-qualified-revenue objective; matching a competitor's entry pricing buys price-sensitive accounts that memory says do not stick. Memory_57 (referrals) and memory_44 (enterprise sales-assist) both look sound but neither addresses the specific regressions this quarter; referrals amplify an activation funnel that is currently leaking, and enterprise sales-assist is a different segment from the SMB accounts under attack. Memory_91 (activation messaging) is the live alternative and I may fall back to it if verification undermines the onboarding pair; it is single-sourced, which is part of why it is second choice. Downstream value risk: stripping signup fields and onboarding steps can improve completion while degrading lead qualification data, which is precisely the input the sales-assisted enterprise path in memory_44 depends on, so a completion lift could quietly cost pipeline quality. I will instrument for qualified-revenue and enterprise-routing effects, not just completion rate, and treat all of these memories as descriptions of a pre-competitor market that may no longer hold on day 76.
